spell.tfc_practical_arcana.freshwell.gui: Gather fresh water with mana to fill a barrel.
spell.tfc_practical_arcana.brinewell.gui: Gather fresh water with mana and infuse it with salt to fill a barrel.
spell.tfc_practical_arcana.rekindle.guid: Gather environmental mana around dead torches and unlit candles in a certain radius, and turn the mana into fire to light them. Will also restart burn time for all lit torches and candles.
spell.tfc_practical_arcana.preserve.guid: By blessing the food, you can slow down spoiling and preserve it for longer.
spell.tfc_practical_arcana.revitalize.gu: Agitate vital energy in crops to temporarily revitalize them. NOTE: If the crop lacks the survival conditions, it will die again shortly.
ui.tfc_practical_arcana.cast_error_targe: This spell requires a barrel as a target.
This spell requires an empty barrel, or a barrel with %s.
This spell requires the barrel to be open.
ui.tfc_practical_arcana.cast_error_not_f: This spell requires you to hold food item in your main hand.
